requirements.text: As a player, I want to create a new Texas Hold'em game room with standard, default settings so that I can start a game for others to join.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 asked about room creation parameters and Spk 1 said 'As long as I can find a table and start playing, I don't need to worry about the specific settings', implying a create room feature; Spk 0 captured this in user stories.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to see a clear visual representation of the poker table, my cards, community cards, and the pot so that I can follow the state of the game.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly listed this as a user story, and Spk 1 did not object.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to access and manage my basic account information (e.g., display name and email) so that I can maintain my access to the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder indicates the need to manage account details, and the analyst includes it as user story 10.

requirements.text: As a player, I want the system to be web-based so that I can access and play the game through a web browser.
requirements.rationale: User Story 5 explicitly mentions 'web-based', indicating the platform expectation.

requirements.text: As a player, I want the system to store the state of each poker game (e.g., players, cards, pot, blinds) so that the game can progress correctly.
requirements.rationale: Playing Texas Hold'em requires tracking game state, though the stakeholder did not specify storage explicitly.

requirements.text: The system should log authentication events and access to game history records to support security review.
requirements.rationale: Any system handling personal data and account access requires audit logging to meet common security and regulatory standards.

requirements.text: The system should protect player personal data (e.g., email, game history) from unauthorized access.
requirements.rationale: Personal data such as email and game history require encryption to comply with data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

requirements.text: As a player, I want the system to support a standard Texas Hold'em online game with no external system dependencies for gameplay so that I can play independently.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 shows no interest in integrations with external game types or services, implying the system is self-contained for the Texas Hold'em experience.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to view a basic list of my past games (game records) so that I can see a history of my activity.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 stated 'I just want to see a list of games I've played' and Spk 0 captured this in user stories.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to view a lobby showing available Texas Hold'em game rooms so that I can find a table to join.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly listed this as a user story based on the conversation, and Spk 1 did not object.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to perform standard poker actions (check, bet, call, raise, fold) during my turn so that I can participate in the hand.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly listed this as a user story, and Spk 1 did not object.

requirements.text: The web-based Texas Hold'em game shall support standard table sizes (e.g., 6, 8, or 9 players) to accommodate typical poker room configurations.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder accepts any standard table size, and 9 is a common maximum; this sets a capacity limit for table design and performance.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to create an account and log in using a simple authentication method so that I can access my personal game information and history.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 stated 'I just need to be able to access my account and game history without any issues' and Spk 0 summarized this requirement in the user stories.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to send and receive standard text chat messages with other players at my table so that I can engage in casual conversation and banter during the game.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 stated 'I just want to be able to talk to the people at my table while we play. Standard banter is fine' and Spk 0 captured this in user stories.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to join an existing Texas Hold'em game room from the lobby so that I can play with other players.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly listed this as a user story, and Spk 1 did not object.

requirements.text: As a player, I want to play a standard, web-based game of Texas Hold'em at a virtual table so that I can enjoy the core poker experience.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 repeatedly said 'I just want to play some Texas Hold'em' and Spk 0 captured this as a user story.

requirements.text: As a player, I want a chat feature available at the table so that I can engage in casual conversation and banter during the game.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 repeatedly asks about chat functionality scope, implying the system must support chat in both table and lobby areas.
